m1.typescript: m1 the loop runs scaled actions and sends every result in one message

e1.typescript: e1 the screen is scaled to what the model may see and clicks are scaled back

e2.typescript: e2 a click on a risky element needs a persons confirmation

e3.typescript: e3 a failed action stops the rest of its batch

e4.typescript: e4 invalid actions come back as error results with a reason

e5.typescript: e5 the loop ends on a stop reason or at the turn limit

e6.typescript: e6 old screenshots are replaced so the context does not fill up

e7.typescript: e7 screenshots and zooms are sent at the size the model may see

wrong-unscaled-click.defect: uses the model's coordinates as screen coordinates without scaling them back

wrong-no-confirm.defect: clicks a payment element without asking a person

wrong-continue-after-failure.defect: keeps running the actions of a batch after one has failed

wrong-result-per-message.defect: sends each tool result in a user message of its own

wrong-screenshot-full-size.defect: sends the screenshot at the full screen size instead of the scaled size

wrong-prune-oldest-kept.defect: keeps the oldest screenshots and removes the newest

wrong-extra-turn.defect: makes one model call more than the turn limit
